methods.limits: -vn disables video and -c:a pcm_s16le selects the audio encoder.
-vn disables video and -b:a sets the audio bitrate; MP3 encoding goes through the external LAME library.
-c:a selects the audio codec; the command sets no sample rate.

methods.steps: Open the AVIF and choose File > Export As, then save with a .webp name. The WebP Export dialog offers Lossless, Image quality, and options to save Exif, XMP and the color profile.
methods.limits: GIMP does not support animated AVIF.
WebP needs the WebP delegate library.

methods.steps: Select the CR2; File > Convert and save; choose JPEG and save the new file.
methods.limits: Requires a camera supported by that DPP version; applies development recipes.

methods.steps: Select the image; open export; target storage file on disk; file format JPEG; start export.
methods.limits: Camera support, development history and export profile affect the rendered photograph.
ImageMagick lists CR2 as read-only and requires the explicit cr2: specifier.

methods.steps: Develop the CR3; export module > file on disk; choose PNG, depth and profile; start export.
methods.limits: The camera must be one darktable supports.

methods.steps: File > Export > To a picture file; choose source scope, destination and JPG; Export.
methods.limits: Windows viewer; frame, annotation and image-size options change the picture output.

methods.steps: Click Export or Ctrl+E; select JPEG and image/series scope; Export; choose a folder.
methods.limits: Rendered image exports do not replace the original DICOM study.
The DCM reader is read-only and handles window center and width tags.

methods.steps: Develop DNG; export module: file on disk and JPEG; set destination; start export.
methods.limits: Supported DNG variants and the current development history determine the result.
ImageMagick lists DNG as read-only and requires the explicit dng: specifier.

methods.steps: Open the EXR and choose File > Export As. The PNG Export dialog offers a Pixel format of 8 or 16 bits per channel, with or without alpha.
methods.limits: A single PNG does not retain every EXR production channel.

methods.steps: Open EXR; File > Export; choose PNG.
methods.limits: EXR stores no color space, so Krita assigns a default on load.
ImageMagick lists EXR as read and write and requires the OpenEXR library.

methods.steps: Import FLAC; File > Export Audio; select M4A (AAC) Files (FFmpeg) from the format menu.
methods.limits: AAC export needs the optional FFmpeg library; the manual records that the bit rate setting is not always honored.
